pictures.scene: Attributed to Jacob Cornelisz van Oostsanen, The Laughing Fool — the jester in his eared cap laughing behind his own hand, for the choirmaster according to Mahalath a Maskil of David, the fool says in his heart
pictures.name: pd_the_laughing_fool

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Belshazzar's Feast — the king who said there is no God turning from his cup to the hand writing his sentence on the wall, there is no God, they are corrupt their ways are vile
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_belshazzars_feast

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Fight between Carnival and Lent — the whole town square given over to drinking, gambling and brawling, there is no one who does good, God looks down from heaven
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_fight_between_carnival_and_lent

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Ghent Altarpiece, God the Father — the Lord enthroned in gold and looking straight out at the world below, upon the sons of men, to see if any understand
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_the_father

pictures.scene: Hieronymus Bosch, The Pedlar — the ragged traveler looking back over his shoulder at the house he is leaving behind him, if any seek God, all have turned away
pictures.name: pd_bosch_the_pedlar

pictures.scene: Jan Steen, Beware of Luxury — the household gone to ruin with the pig rooting through the spilled goods and the cards lying on the floor, they have together become corrupt, there is no one who does good
pictures.name: pd_steen_beware_of_luxury

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Cardsharps — the boy cheating with the cards hidden behind his back while his partner signals the hand, not even one, will the workers of iniquity never learn
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_the_cardsharps

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Massacre of the Innocents — the armored troop riding into the snowbound village and taking it house by house, they devour my people like bread, they refuse to call upon God
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_massacre_of_the_innocents

pictures.scene: Ludolf Bakhuizen, Christ in the Storm on the Sea of Galilee — the little boat thrown up on the wave with the men clinging to the sail in the dark, there they are overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to fear
pictures.name: pd_bakhuizen_christ_in_the_storm_on_the_sea_of_galilee

pictures.scene: Vasily Vereshchagin, The Apotheosis of War — the heaped pyramid of skulls left standing in the empty plain with the crows over it, for God has scattered the bones, of those who besieged you
pictures.name: pd_vereshchagin_the_apotheosis_of_war

pictures.scene: Paul Delaroche, Napoleon at Fontainebleau — the conqueror slumped in the chair with his sword laid aside on the day he gave everything up, you put them to shame, for God has despised them
pictures.name: pd_delaroche_napoleon_at_fontainebleau

pictures.scene: Jean-Léon Gérôme, The Wailing Wall — the one man standing with his book against the great stones of Zion, oh that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion, when God restores His captive people
pictures.name: pd_gerome_the_wailing_wall

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Peasant Wedding — the bride sitting under the green cloth while the whole barn is fed and the dishes come in, let Jacob rejoice let Israel be glad
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_peasant_wedding

lines.text: For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath. A Maskil of David.
The fool says in his heart,
“There is no God.”
They are corrupt; their ways are vile.
There is no one who does good.
God looks down from heaven
upon the sons of men
to see if any understand,
if any seek God.
All have turned away,
they have together become corrupt;
there is no one who does good,
not even one.
Will the workers of iniquity never learn?
They devour my people like bread;
they refuse to call upon God.
There they are, overwhelmed with dread,
where there was nothing to fear.
For God has scattered the bones
of those who besieged you.
You put them to shame,
for God has despised them.
Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion!
When God restores His captive people,
let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
